summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Garwood Glow JA. All 13 backend pytest tests pass (auth, glow-guide with LLM reasoning, quotes CRUD + admin auth, uploads + protected file download). Frontend Playwright flows pass: home loads with hero/CTAs, AI Glow Guide generates recommendation + 3-card comparison + non-empty reasoning + 5 factors + navigates to /quote via Lock In, multi-step Quote wizard submits and shows branded confirmation, Admin login redirects to /admin dashboard with stat cards and quote rows, View opens detail modal, status change (set-status-scheduled) persists after reload (stat-scheduled increment verified).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 96-113 uses request.headers manual parsing for auth instead of FastAPI's HTTPBearer security dependency — works fine but reduces OpenAPI docs quality; minor.
Public /api/uploads has no size/type validation — a large or non-image file could be uploaded. Consider MIME whitelist + max size to prevent abuse.
startup uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event decorators; consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
score_packages: recommended package could equal an alternate if scoring ties across property/urgency — not currently a problem given data, but tie-breaker could stabilise output.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST quotes (TEST_User, TEST Client) via public /api/quotes for admin dashboard verification. Also created a small PNG upload via /api/uploads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are stable. Admin dashboard testids follow pattern quote-row-{id}, quote-view-{id}, set-status-{status}. Detail modal testid = quote-detail-modal. LLM reasoning via emergentintegrations works with claude-sonnet-4-6; fallback text also verified. Prices intentionally show 'Custom Quote'.
